evidence.proved: the error catalogue lists FREE_TIER_RATE_LIMITED as the 429 per-IP free-tier limit of 30 per minute and 300 per hour
free-model pool exhaustion surfaces as FREE_MODEL_FAILED (non-streaming) or STREAM_FAILED (streaming), published as 429 with Retry-After 30
evidence.quote: Separately, when the free model pool itself is out of capacity (every free rung is throttled or unhealthy upstream), the response is `429` with `code: "STREAM_FAILED"` (streaming) or `"FREE_MODEL_FAILED"` (non-streaming) and `Retry-After: 30`.
